queries.query: Wonju official cadastral parcel map geospatial portal Korea
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Wonju municipal Life Geography Map, its continuous cadastral-map layer, and the municipality's GeoServer WMS/WFS gateway. National K-GeoP was also identified, but the local municipal service provides the city-specific source.

queries.query: 원주시 공식 지적도 토지정보시스템 연속지적도 공간정보
queries.result: 공식 원주시 생활지리 지도에서 연속지적도 레이어를 확인했고, 현재 JavaScript 설정에서 원주시 GeoServer의 LP_PA_CBND 레이어와 EPSG:5186 WMS/WFS 서비스를 확인했다.

registryCustodian: Wonju City municipal geospatial/map service; the public Life Geography Map exposes the continuous cadastral map and the city-specific GeoServer gateway.

registryEvidence.evidence: The official municipal page labels the layer 연속지적도 (continuous cadastral map). Its current JavaScript config names the service layer wonju:LP_PA_CBND and the gateway /gs-gate/wms; the public WFS capabilities lists the same feature type with Wonju coverage and EPSG:5186.

sourceReview.service: Wonju municipal Life Geography Map / GeoServer continuous cadastral layer LP_PA_CBND
sourceReview.nativeFieldMapping: Feature id is the GeoServer/native layer identity (LP_PA_CBND.<numeric suffix>); returned source attributes included PNU, JIBUN and BCHK but were not retained in the sample.
sourceReview.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key constructed; the stable feature id supplied by WFS was used.
sourceReview.crs: EPSG:5186 in the service response; retained sample is in EPSG:5186 with an explicit GeoJSON CRS member.

requestOutcomes.outcome: 200; official map HTML exposed CSRF configuration and map-service metadata.

200; WFS capabilities listed wonju:LP_PA_CBND as a queryable feature type, EPSG:5186, and Wonju lat/lon bounds.

200; bounded anonymous FeatureCollection reported totalFeatures=27 and returned three safe-reviewable parcel features with native ids and full MultiPolygon geometry. Raw attributes were inspected only in ignored scratch evidence.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact WUP point was preserved and tested through the official coordinate-to-PNU route; no hit/miss inference was made from its result.
requestEvidence: full polygon retained with safe native id only

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Wonju municipal continuous cadastral map layer LP_PA_CBND.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official public WFS layer with Wonju-wide bounding box in capabilities; one bounded response inspected near the exact point.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [37.3421161760985,127.949470395472] and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted.
The WFS bbox was a bounded service/schema test, not evidence of complete citywide extraction; citywideVerified remains false.
The coordinate-to-PNU response had no returned parcel object; this is not evidence of parcel absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, title, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion records research only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The public municipal WFS exposes safe parcel identities and geometry, but currentness, exact administrative city-boundary completeness, field semantics beyond the observed identity, and production adapter suitability require independent serial review.
